# Bundled libraries

- esptool-js 0.7.1: https://github.com/espressif/esptool-js — Apache-2.0. Distributed browser bundle from https://unpkg.com/esptool-js@0.7.1/bundle.js, unchanged. Includes Espressif flash stubs and pako compression code.
- SparkMD5 3.0.2: https://github.com/satazor/js-spark-md5 — MIT. Minified browser distribution, unchanged.
- pako 2.1.0: https://github.com/nodeca/pako — MIT and Zlib. Included inside the esptool-js bundle; license supplied separately.

The local licenses accompany this release. No third-party runtime network requests are needed for programming.
